proposals.title: Shareholder Proposal Requesting Audited Report on Impact to Chemicals Business under the System Change Scenario
proposals.proponent: As You Sow on behalf of Handlery Hotels, Inc. and Meyer Memorial Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an audited report addressing whether and how a significant reduction in virgin plastic demand under Breaking the Plastic Wave's System Change Scenario would affect the Company's financial position and financial statement assumptions.
